title: Unit-entry cancellation of a natural-degree finite free complex
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and C a natural-degree chain complex [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] with bases b_i indexed by Fin(n_i) [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Fix j≥0 and pivot indices p∈Fin(n_(j+1)), q∈Fin(n_j) whose differential coefficient is a unit. There exist C′, sizes n′ and a homotopy equivalence e:C′→C with injective forward components and bases of C′_i indexed by Fin(n′_i), such that n′_(j+1)+1=n_(j+1), n′_j+1=n_j, and n′_i=n_i away from these two degrees.

proof.text: Normalize the target pivot coordinate by the inverse unit, obtaining β, and put α=βd, z=b_(j+1)(p), w=d(z). Compute α(z)=β(w)=1 and β(b_j(q)) a unit. Obtain bases of the two kernels by the kernel-basis theorem.

The complex identities give αd_(j+2)=0 and d_j(w)=0. Apply the split-functional deformation-retract theorem. Transfer the kernel bases and the original bases via its degreewise linear equivalences. Set n′ to subtract one at the special degrees; positivity follows from p and q, giving the size equations.

mathlib_searches.query: Split functionals with value one on a vector give a deformation retract of a chain complex onto their kernels
A chain complex with a unit matrix differential coefficient splits off a contractible two term complex and has a smaller homotopy equivalent finite free complex
mathlib_searches.results: Generic localization, alternating complex, and Dold-Kan infrastructure; no supplied functional kernel deformation-retract construction.
HomotopyEquiv.quasiIso_hom, quasiIso_inv, quasiIsoAt_hom and quasiIsoAt_inv apply after a homotopy equivalence is built; none builds the complement.
Nine unrelated topology or derived-functor matches; no kernel-complement deformation retract. Also read Homotopy structure and generic shape extension/restriction APIs.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_nat_homotopy_cancellation_of_isUnit_entry
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (C : ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℕ)
    (n : ℕ → ℕ) (b : ∀ i : ℕ, Module.Basis (Fin (n i)) R (C.X i))
    (j : ℕ) (p : Fin (n (j + 1))) (q : Fin (n j))
    (hu : IsUnit (LinearMap.toMatrix (b (j + 1)) (b j)
      (C.d (j + 1) j).hom q p)) :
    ∃ (C' : ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℕ) (n' : ℕ → ℕ)
      (e : HomotopyEquiv C' C),
      (∀ i : ℕ, Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin (n' i)) R (C'.X i))) ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, Function.Injective (e.hom.f i).hom) ∧
      n' (j + 1) + 1 = n (j + 1) ∧ n' j + 1 = n j ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≠ j + 1 → i ≠ j → n' i = n i)
